title: Signature Funnel delivery-rail receipt line (P4-MEDIA and P7-BUILD)
description: One line of <run_dir>/delegation_receipts.jsonl written by the delivery rail named in brief.delivery_rail, through delegation_receipt.record() at call time. Skill 49 never resolves the rail name to code: it only checks that the rail signed these lines with the operator key (delegation_receipt.require_signed) and that each line has this shape (delegation_receipt.require_rail). P4-MEDIA carries one line per ledger image key; P7-BUILD carries one line per page type.

provider.description: the delivery rail's own name, as brief.delivery_rail

remote_id.description: P4: the hosted media id; P7: the built page id

covers.description: P4: the ledger image key; P7: the page type
